Hello, Welcome to Chat Doctor, Shingles is caused by reactivation of varicella zoster virus which has been dormant in the dorsal root ganglion since the time of chicken pox. The virus is spread through direct contact with the fluid from the blisters. It is important to treat shingles as soon as possible because it can cause complications such as post herpetic neuralgia (pain after the rash has gone away) and bacterial infection. The treatment is usually with antiviral medication like acyclovir or valacyclovir. These medications should be started within 72 hours of the onset of the rash. They will help reduce the severity and duration of the illness. Thank you.
